title: Welcome!
subtitleLogin: Sign in to your Kidville account
subtitlePicker: You have more than one profile. Choose which role to sign in with.
forgotNote: Contact the school office: they will re-issue your credentials by email. Access is by invitation only.
erroreRuolo: Couldn’t set the role. Please try again.
credenzialiNonValide: Invalid credentials. Access is by invitation from the school office only.
servizioNonDisponibile: The service is unavailable right now. This is not a problem with your credentials: please try again in a few minutes.
troppiTentativi: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
timeoutAccesso: The server didn’t respond in time. Check your connection and try again.
timeoutDopoAccesso: We recognised you, but your profile didn’t arrive in time. Your credentials are correct: please try again.

erroreImprevisto: Unexpected error while signing in. This is not a problem with your credentials: try again and, if it persists, contact the school office.
